inventory.label: the second hickory kernel
inventory.notes: Pried out of a frost-cracked crevice on the rocky shoulder above the north bank, in territory the fox kept off-limits until this morning. YY ate the first kernel on the spot, tucked the second into the back of the pantry shelf at the treehouse — the first deliberate save of the season.

identity_notes: Late winter — YY has now made the season's first deliberate food save: a second hickory kernel set aside at home.
Yesterday: dove paws-out at the brook's eddy for soaked beechnuts.
Today: noticed the fox-smell was missing at the scratch-pine; crossed the line, climbed the rocky shoulder, and found two whole hickory kernels in a frost-cracked crevice. Ate one. Stored one.
Standing thread: the rocky shoulder is new ground; the warm patch and the brook's surge stretch are still his alone.
